case.label: // CASE STUDY — 001
case.headline: E-Commerce Platform: Zero to 99.9% Uptime
case.p1: A growing e-commerce client was running a single VPS with manual deployments, no monitoring, and a deploy process that regularly caused 30-minute outages during business hours.
case.p2: Over 3 weeks, I re-architected their entire infrastructure: containerized all services, built a GitLab CI pipeline, deployed a Proxmox HA cluster, and set up full observability.
case.p3: Result: zero unplanned downtime in 8 months. Deploy time dropped from 45 minutes to 90 seconds.
case.tl_problem_desc: A single VPS, manual SSH deploys, and zero monitoring — every release risked a 30-minute outage during business hours.
case.tl_architecture_desc: Mapped a layered, highly-available design: CDN edge, load-balanced app tier, and a replicated data layer with clear failure domains.
case.tl_infrastructure_desc: Provisioned a Proxmox HA cluster with ZFS storage pools, containerized every service, and codified it all with Ansible & Terraform.
case.tl_networking_desc: Nginx HA reverse proxy with SSL termination, rate limiting, and a Cloudflare edge for DDoS protection and global caching.
case.tl_deployment_desc: A GitOps CI/CD pipeline: push to main → tested, built, and rolled out with zero-downtime blue-green releases in under 90 seconds.
case.tl_operations_desc: Full observability with Prometheus, Grafana, and alerting — plus hourly snapshots and a tested disaster-recovery plan.
